metadata.title: The Tribal Kitchen | #adivasi #tribal #madhyapradesh #cooking #fish
metadata.description: Durga is a young girl from Lakhanpur village on the water reservoir of Bargi Dam in Mandla district of Madhya Pradesh. She is member of a family which was displaced when Bargi Dam was constructed. She is a school drop out and helps her mother in cooking and other work at home.
